title: Fine-Tuning Methods — Full Updates Are Expensive
key_insight: Full fine-tuning offers maximum flexibility. Parameter-efficient methods train small additions or selected parameters while keeping most base weights frozen.
body:
## Full Updates Are Expensive

Updating every parameter requires gradients and optimizer state for the whole model. That can use several times the weight memory.

Full fine-tuning offers maximum flexibility. Parameter-efficient methods train small additions or selected parameters while keeping most base weights frozen.

Choose by data size, compute, deployment, and behavior gap. A tiny dataset with full updates can overfit or damage useful general behavior.
common_mistakes: Fine-tuning changes behavior without any examples.
Every input token should always be treated as the desired assistant output.
A preference dataset represents universal values automatically.
mini_exercise: Draw “Full Updates Are Expensive” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Fine-tuning can shape format, domain behavior, and task skill when prompting or retrieval is insufficient.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Full Updates Are Expensive,” explain Fine-Tuning Methods without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
